hooks.powershell: $in=''; try { $in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd() } catch { }; if ($in -match 'rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+(/(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|~|\$HOME)|mkfs\.|dd\s[^|]*of=/dev/[sh]d') { Write-Output (@{ permissionDecision = 'deny'; permissionDecisionReason = 'pre-tool-use: destructive command pattern blocked' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }; exit 0
